newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Saks joins recommended list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Saks joins recommended list.

text.p: --Furman Selz said Thursday it added Saks Holdings Inc to its recommended list, upgrading its opinion from neutral on the stock.
--It said Saks' February sales are running well despite a tough 14.9 percent year-ago comparable-store sales comparison. Its Q4 earnings per share estimate on the retailer is $0.71.
--"We are bumping up our FY97 EPS to $1.72 from a low-end estimate of $1.67 and taking our FY98 estimate to $2.25 from $2.20," said analyst Kimberly Walin in a report.
--Furman Selz' nine-month price target is in the low $40s.
